description:
AI Engineer 
  
 Location: Austin Texas. 
 Type: Fixed Term Employee (6 months with possible extension, including Benefits). 
  
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a AI Engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade AI systems for complex enterprise environments. 
 The role spans the complete AI engineering lifecycle: data and knowledge preparation, model adaptation and training, knowledge graphs, retrieval, agentic workflows, evaluation, deployment, and continuous improvement. 
 You will help establish modern engineering practices for Software 3.0 , where system behavior is shaped not only through traditional code, but also through models, data, knowledge, prompts, tools, policies, evaluations, 
 Responsibilities 
 Design and build production-grade AI agents and multi-agent workflows. 
 Build AI systems that combine traditional software, machine learning models, enterprise knowledge, retrieval, and reasoning. 
 Adapt and optimize foundation models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning, instruction tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, distillation, and preference-based optimization. 
 Develop data pipelines for dataset creation, curation, labeling, quality validation, versioning, and governance. 
 Design enterprise knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic models, and graph-based retrieval capabilities. 
 Combine knowledge graphs, vector search, relational data, and document retrieval to improve contextual accuracy and explainability. 
 Apply neuro-symbolic and hybrid AI techniques that combine deterministic rules, structured knowledge, statistical models, and LLM reasoning. 
 Build tool-using agents with planning, memory, structured outputs, and controlled execution. 
 Develop evaluation frameworks for models, retrieval systems, agents, and end-to-end business outcomes. 
 Implement safeguards for authorization, human approval, auditability, validation, rollback, and safe failure. 
 Optimize AI systems for quality, latency, throughput, reliability, and cost. 
 Build reusable AI platform components, APIs, SDKs, and engineering patterns. 
 Establish observability, automated testing, CI/CD, and continuous evaluation for AI workloads. 
 Lead technical designs and architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and influence engineering standards. 
  
 Eligibility Requirements 
 Required Qualifications 
 8+ years of professional software engineering, machine learning engineering, or applied AI experience. 
 Strong production experience with Python , asynchronous programming, type-safe development, API design, and distributed systems. 
 Demonstrated experience deploying and operating machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI systems in production. 
 Experience with one or more deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX . 
 Practical experience with foundation models and techniques such as:  Supervised fine-tuning 
 Instruction tuning 
 Parameter-efficient fine-tuning using LoRA or QLoRA 
 Model distillation and quantization 
 Preference optimization or reinforcement learning from feedback 
 Synthetic-data generation and data augmentation 
 
 Experience designing datasets and pipelines for training, evaluation, and continuous improvement. 
 Strong understanding of LLM architecture, tokenization, embeddings, inference, context management, and model serving. 
 Experience building agentic or multi-step AI workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangChain, CrewAI , or a custom orchestration framework. 
 Strong knowledge of:  Tool and function calling 
 Structured model outputs 
 Prompt and context engineering 
 Agent planning and memory 
 RAG, GraphRAG, embeddings, retrieval, and re-ranking 
 Model, retrieval, and agent evaluation 
 
 Experience with knowledge-graph concepts, including entities, relationships, ontologies, taxonomies, semantic modeling, and graph traversal. 
 Experience with graph technologies such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB Gremlin API, RDF, OWL, SPARQL , or comparable platforms and standards. 
 Experience implementing responsible autonomy through guardrails, policy enforcement, human oversight, audit trails, and operational controls. 
 Experience with relational databases, vector databases, automated testing, observability, and CI/CD. 
 Ability to translate research concepts into secure, supportable, and measurable enterprise solutions. 
  
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience building GraphRAG , hybrid retrieval, or neuro-symbolic AI solutions. 
 Experience with model training and serving platforms such as Hugging Face, NVIDIA NeMo, Ray, MLflow, Kubeflow , or managed cloud AI platforms. 
 Experience with distributed training, GPU optimization, model parallelism, quantization, and high-performance inference. 
 Familiarity with inference technologies such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server , or ONNX Runtime . 
 Experience developing or integrating Model Context Protocol , agent-to-agent interfaces, or secure AI tool ecosystems. 
 Familiarity with AI security risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse, model poisoning, and unsafe autonomous execution. 
 Understanding of model and data governance, lineage, explainability, privacy, and responsible AI practices. 
 Contributions to open-source AI projects, patents, research publications, or recognized technical communities 
  
 In the US, the target base salary for this role is $175,000-$180,000. Compensation is based on a range of factors that include relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and geography. We expect the majority of candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall throughout the range based on these factors 
  
 About eClerx 
 eClerx is a leading provider of productized services, bringing together people, technology and domain expertise to amplify business results.​ 

 The firm provides business process management, automation, and analytics services to a number of Fortune 2000 enterprises, including some of the world’s leading financial services, communications, retail, fashion, media & entertainment, manufacturing, travel & leisure, and technology companies. Incorporated in 2000, eClerx is traded on both the Bombay and National Stock Exchanges of India. The firm employs more than 19,000 people across Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Switzerland, Egypt. India, Italy, Netherlands, Peru, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, the UK, and the USA.
